founders.background: Founder of Snyk (valuation $7.4B), security veteran and former Akamai CTO

product.summary: A Spec-centric development platform where AI takes natural-language specs, tests, and contracts as input to generate and maintain code, rather than humans writing code directly. It shifts the single source of truth for both humans and AI from code to specs.
product.problem_statement: Current AI coding tools treat code as the unit of output; once generated, code is difficult to modify, understand, or regenerate. As a result, even AI-generated code ends up being maintained by humans.
product.solution: Specs, tests, and docs are first-class objects; code is treated as a derived artifact. Changes always start from specs, and AI regenerates code, tests, and infrastructure. Humans and agents collaborate on the same spec.
key_features: Spec Workspace: an integrated editor for natural-language specs and tests
Code Generator: auto-generates multilingual code and tests from specs
Drift Detector: automatically detects mismatches between code and specs
Agent SDK: autonomous agents that operate on top of specs
Enterprise security and audit logs
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Spec/test DSL, bidirectional code-spec synchronization, multi-agent workflows, and formal verification integration
product.target_customer: Startups starting new codebases in the AI era and enterprises driving legacy modernization
product.business_model: Enterprise seat-based SaaS + usage-based pricing for autonomous work units + dedicated hosting option

direct_competitors.comparison: Autonomous SWE agents. Tessl's paradigm differs by demoting code itself from first-class status and putting specs at the center.

product.summary: Integrated MLOps platform operating GPU training, hyperparameter tuning, experiment management, model serving, and LLM fine-tuning on a single screen. Supports on-premises GPU, hybrid cloud, and on-premise, and schedules multi-GPU jobs on AWS and GCP.
product.problem_statement: AI teams operate GPU clusters, training pipelines, experiment management, and model serving separately, spending more than half their time on infrastructure. It's even harder to use on-premises GPUs and cloud efficiently together.
product.solution: A Kubernetes-based unified control plane pools on-premises GPUs, cloud, and on-premise into one, and runs training to serving in the same workflow UI. Combined with LLM fine-tuning, LoRA, and RLHF lineup, it significantly reduces infrastructure overhead in the LLM era.
